comments: There are no specific comments on the publication. Cepheid moduli are compiled and homogenized from earlier HST Key Project and independent studies. Previous author included it.
Key Project HST V,I photometry is refitted with fixed OGLE-LMC PL relations. The reported uncertainty is random and includes PL scatter plus reddening coupling; no metallicity term is used.
Final period-cut Wesenheit fit before abundance correction. e_R is the random PL-fit error only; N_cef is the post-cut sample.
Maximum-light LMC PL solution. It is 0.018 mag shorter than the representative mean-light value.
Representative mean-light OGLE LMC solution. CTE corrected but not metallicity corrected.
